```{r config, include=FALSE}
# Repository location, separate from DATA_ROOT. Replace with the absolute path

REPO_ROOT <- normalizePath(REPO_ROOT, mustWork = TRUE)
# Input locations. Set these before knitting.
DATA_ROOT <- "" # project data directory (per-analysis subdirectories)
```

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = file.path(DATA_ROOT, "Reference_Bias/Real_Animals/"))
set.seed(0)

require("ggplot2")
require("cowplot")
require("viridis")
require("reshape2")
require("dplyr")
require("tidyverse")
library(plotly)
```

```{r make figure directory}
# make figure directory
if (!dir.exists("Figures")) {
  dir.create("Figures")
}
```

```{r import ecdf functions}
# find all ecdf_*.rds files in the directory
ecdf_files <- list.files(path = file.path(DATA_ROOT, "Reference_Bias/Real_Animals/"), pattern = "ecdf_.*\\.rds", full.names = TRUE)

# create a list to store the ecdf functions
ecdf_list <- list()
# loop through the files and read the ecdf functions
for (file in ecdf_files) {
  # extract the name of the file without the path and extension
  file_name <- gsub("ecdf_|\\.rds", "", basename(file))
  # read the ecdf function from the file
  ecdf_list[[file_name]] <- readRDS(file)
}

# check the names of the ecdf functions
ecdf_names <- names(ecdf_list)

# remove ".parsed.bed" from the names
ecdf_names <- gsub("\\.parsed\\.bed.gz", "", ecdf_names)

# replace "true-dip.CC" with "CC"
#ecdf_names <- gsub("true-dip.CC", "true-dip", ecdf_names)

# parse name to get {Genome}.{Cross} split by "."
Genome <- str_split(ecdf_names, "_", simplify = TRUE)[,1]
Cross <- str_split(ecdf_names, "_", simplify = TRUE)[,2]
```

```{r process ecdf functions to generate dataframe}
lapply(
  1:length(ecdf_list),
  function(I) data.frame(
              referenceFraction=seq(0,1,0.01),
              percentile=unlist(lapply(seq(0,1,0.01), function(X) ecdf_list[[I]](X))),
              Genome=Genome[I],
              Cross=Cross[I]
            )
) %>% bind_rows() -> ReferenceFraction_Percentile_Data


ReferenceFraction_Percentile_Data$Genome <- gsub("Pangenome", "Pangenome", ReferenceFraction_Percentile_Data$Genome)
ReferenceFraction_Percentile_Data$Genome <- gsub("BWA", "mm10", ReferenceFraction_Percentile_Data$Genome)

# Correct the Cross names, replace "_" with "/"
ReferenceFraction_Percentile_Data$Cross <- gsub("-", "x", ReferenceFraction_Percentile_Data$Cross)
```

```{r plot all ecdf functions curves, include=TRUE, fig.width=2.5, fig.height=5}
ggplot(ReferenceFraction_Percentile_Data, aes(x=referenceFraction, y=percentile, color=Cross)) +
  geom_line(linewidth=0.2) +
  facet_grid(Genome~.) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0.5, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey15") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.5, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey15") +
  JFMVTheme +
  theme(legend.position = "none") +
  labs(x="Reference fraction", y="Percentile") +
  #scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0,1,0.1)) +
  #scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0,1,0.1)) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(size=10),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size=10),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size=12),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size=12),
    strip.text.x = element_text(size=12),
    strip.text.y = element_text(size=12)
  ) -> p1

p1

# save as png and as svg
ggsave("Figures/ReferenceAlignmentBias_splitbyassembly_ECDFs.png", plot=p1, width=2.5, height=5, dpi=300)
ggsave("Figures/ReferenceAlignmentBias_splitbyassembly_ECDFs.svg", plot=p1, width=2.5, height=5)
```

```{r calculate intervals per referenceFraction}
lapply(
  unique(ReferenceFraction_Percentile_Data$referenceFraction),
  function(I) lapply(
                unique(ReferenceFraction_Percentile_Data$Genome),
                function(J) data.frame(
                  referenceFraction=I,
                  Genome=J,
                  min=min(subset(ReferenceFraction_Percentile_Data, Genome==J & referenceFraction==I)$percentile),
                  max=max(subset(ReferenceFraction_Percentile_Data, Genome==J & referenceFraction==I)$percentile),
                  mean=mean(subset(ReferenceFraction_Percentile_Data, Genome==J & referenceFraction==I)$percentile),
                  median=median(subset(ReferenceFraction_Percentile_Data, Genome==J & referenceFraction==I)$percentile),
                  sd=sd(subset(ReferenceFraction_Percentile_Data, Genome==J & referenceFraction==I)$percentile)
                  )
                )
      ) %>% bind_rows() -> ReferenceFraction_Percentile_Intervals
```

```{r plot intervals, include=TRUE, fig.width=2.5, fig.height=2.25}
ggplot(ReferenceFraction_Percentile_Intervals, aes(x=referenceFraction, y=mean, fill=Genome)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0.6, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey15", linewidth=0.5) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.5, linetype = "solid", color = "grey25", linewidth=0.5) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0.5, linetype = "solid", color = "grey25", linewidth=0.5) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin=min, ymax=max), alpha=0.65) +
  scale_x_continuous(expand=c(0,0), limits=c(0,1), breaks=seq(0,1,0.2)) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand=c(0,0), limits=c(0,1), breaks=seq(0,1,0.2)) +
  JFMVTheme +
  theme(legend.position = "none") +
  labs(x="Reference fraction", y="Cumulative Fraction") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#c03a46", "#447ead")) -> p2

p2

# save as png and as svg
ggsave("Figures/ReferenceAlignmentBias_CumulativeFraction.png", plot=p2, width=2.5, height=2.25, dpi=300)
ggsave("Figures/ReferenceAlignmentBias_CumulativeFraction.svg", plot=p2, width=2.5, height=2.25)
```

```{r calculate referencebias as percentile differences}
calculate_percentile_difference <- function(REFERENCEFRACTION, GENOME, CROSS) {
  
  subset(ReferenceFraction_Percentile_Data, Genome==GENOME & Cross==CROSS & referenceFraction==REFERENCEFRACTION)$percentile->PERCENT
  
  1-PERCENT
}

# Loop through the unique values of Cross and calculate the percentile difference for each combination
percentile_differences <- lapply(
  unique(ReferenceFraction_Percentile_Data$Cross),
  function(CROSS) lapply(
    unique(ReferenceFraction_Percentile_Data$Genome),
    function(GENOME) data.frame(
      Cross=CROSS,
      Genome=GENOME,
      ReferenceBias=calculate_percentile_difference("0.7", GENOME, CROSS)
    )
  )
) %>% bind_rows()

```

```{r summarize ReferenceBias by Cross and Genome}
percentile_differences %>%
  group_by(Genome) %>%
  summarise(meanBiasedFraction=mean(ReferenceBias), 
            sdBiasedFraction=sd(ReferenceBias))
```

```{r plot reference bias, include=TRUE, fig.width=2.75, fig.height=2.25}
ggplot(percentile_differences, aes(x=Genome, y=ReferenceBias, fill=Genome, color=Genome)) +
  geom_violin(trim=TRUE, scale="width", alpha=0.65) +
  geom_beeswarm(size=1, stroke=0, color="black", cex=2) +
  JFMVTheme +
  theme(legend.position = "none") +
  labs(x="Cross", y="Fraction of sites\nwith reference bias") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#c03a46", "#447ead")) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand=c(0,0), limits=c(0,0.15)) -> p3

p3

# save as png and as svg
ggsave("Figures/Fraction_sites_with_RefFraction_AboveThreshold.png", plot=p3, width=2.75, height=2.25, dpi=300)
ggsave("Figures/Fraction_sites_with_RefFraction_AboveThreshold.svg", plot=p3, width=2.75, height=2.25)
```

```{r calculate delta cumulative fraction}
# for each cross, calculate the difference in cumulative fraction (for each reference fraction interval) comparing only CC to mm10
# don't loop through all unique Genome, just CC compared to mm10
lapply(
  unique(ReferenceFraction_Percentile_Data$referenceFraction),
  function(I) lapply(
    unique(ReferenceFraction_Percentile_Data$Cross),
    function(J) data.frame(
      referenceFraction=I,
      Cross=J,
      deltaCumulativeFraction=(subset(ReferenceFraction_Percentile_Intervals, Genome=="Pangenome" & referenceFraction==I)$mean - subset(ReferenceFraction_Percentile_Intervals, Genome=="mm10" & referenceFraction==I)$mean)
    )
  )
) %>% bind_rows() -> ReferenceFraction_Delta_Cumulative_Fraction

# add the two dataframes together
ReferenceFraction_Delta_Cumulative_Fraction$Genome <- "mm10"
```

```{r plot delta cumulative fraction, include=TRUE, fig.width=2.75, fig.height=2.25}
ggplot(ReferenceFraction_Delta_Cumulative_Fraction, aes(x=referenceFraction, y=deltaCumulativeFraction, fill=Genome)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0.6, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey15", linewidth=0.5) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0.5, linetype = "solid", color = "grey25", linewidth=0.5) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "solid", color = "grey25", linewidth=0.5) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin=0, ymax=deltaCumulativeFraction), alpha=0.65) +
  scale_x_continuous(expand=c(0,0), limits=c(0,1), breaks=seq(0,1,0.2)) +
  JFMVTheme +
  theme(legend.position = "none") +
  labs(x="Reference fraction", y="Delta Cumulative\nFraction") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#c03a46", "#447ead")) -> p5

p5

# Save as png and as svg
ggsave("Figures/ReferenceAlignmentBias_DeltaCumulativeFraction.png", plot=p5, width=2.75, height=2.25, dpi=300)
ggsave("Figures/ReferenceAlignmentBias_DeltaCumulativeFraction.svg", plot=p5, width=2.75, height=2.25)
```

```{r perform randomization test ecdf}

perform_randomization_iteration<-function(iteration, DATA){
  
  #print(iteration)
  
  spread(DATA, referenceFraction, percentile) -> DATA.wide
  
  # Randomize Genome
  DATA.wide$Genome <- sample(DATA.wide$Genome)
  
  gather(DATA.wide, referenceFraction, percentile, "0":"1")-> DATA
  
  lapply(
  unique(DATA$referenceFraction),
  function(I) lapply(
                unique(DATA$Genome),
                function(J) data.frame(
                  referenceFraction=I,
                  Genome=J,
                  min=min(subset(DATA, Genome==J & referenceFraction==I)$percentile),
                  max=max(subset(DATA, Genome==J & referenceFraction==I)$percentile),
                  mean=mean(subset(DATA, Genome==J & referenceFraction==I)$percentile),
                  median=median(subset(DATA, Genome==J & referenceFraction==I)$percentile),
                  sd=sd(subset(DATA, Genome==J & referenceFraction==I)$percentile)
                  )
                )
      ) %>% bind_rows() -> Percentile_Intervals
  
  # for each cross, calculate the difference in cumulative fraction (for each reference fraction interval) comparing only CC to mm10
  # don't loop through all unique Genome, just CC compared to mm10
  lapply(
    unique(DATA$referenceFraction),
    function(I) lapply(
      unique(DATA$Cross),
      function(J) data.frame(
        referenceFraction=I,
        Cross=J,
        deltaCumulativeFraction=(subset(Percentile_Intervals, Genome=="Pangenome" & referenceFraction==I)$mean - subset(Percentile_Intervals, Genome=="mm10" & referenceFraction==I)$mean)
      )
    )
  ) %>% bind_rows() -> Delta_Cumulative_Fraction
  
  # add the two dataframes together
  Delta_Cumulative_Fraction$Genome <- "mm10"

  data.frame(
    iteration=iteration,
    max_mm10=max( abs(subset(Delta_Cumulative_Fraction, Genome=="mm10")$deltaCumulativeFraction) )
  )
  
}

set.seed(13)
NumberOfIterations <- 1000
print(NumberOfIterations)
# perform randomization test
lapply(1:NumberOfIterations, function(I) perform_randomization_iteration(I,ReferenceFraction_Percentile_Data)) %>% bind_rows() -> Randomization_Results

```

```{r estimate significance of max delta cumulative fraction, include=TRUE, fig.width=2.5, fig.height=2.25}
max( abs(subset(ReferenceFraction_Delta_Cumulative_Fraction, Genome=="mm10")$deltaCumulativeFraction) )->max_mm10

# generate ecdf of randomization results
ecdf_mm10 <- ecdf(Randomization_Results$max_mm10)

1-ecdf_mm10(max_mm10) -> p_value_mm10

print(paste0("p-value mm10: ", p_value_mm10))

ggplot(Randomization_Results, aes(x=max_mm10)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth=0.001, fill="grey", alpha=0.5) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = max_mm10, linetype = "dashed", color = "#c03a46", linewidth=0.5) +
  JFMVTheme +
  labs(x="ks-statistic", y="Count") +
  scale_x_continuous(expand=c(0,0), limits=c(0,max(Randomization_Results$max_mm10, max_mm10)*1.1)) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand=c(0,0), limits=c(0, 100)) +
  annotate("text", x=max(Randomization_Results$max_mm10, max_mm10)*.75, y=90, label=paste0("p-value: ", round(p_value_mm10, 4)), color="#c03a46", size=3.5) -> p6


p6

# save as png and as svg
ggsave("Figures/RandomizationTest_CC_vs_mm10.png", plot=p6, width=2.5, height=2.25, dpi=300)
ggsave("Figures/RandomizationTest_CC_vs_mm10.svg", plot=p6, width=2.5, height=2.25)
```

```{r import epdf functions}
# find all epdf_*.bed files in the directory
epdf_files <- list.files(path = file.path(DATA_ROOT, "Reference_Bias/Real_Animals/"), pattern = "epdf_.*\\.bed", full.names = TRUE)

# create a list to store the epdf functions
epdf_list <- list()
# loop through the files and read the epdf functions
for (file in epdf_files) {
  # extract the name of the file without the path and extension
  file_name <- gsub("epdf_|\\.rds", "", basename(file))
  # read the epdf function from the file
  epdf_list[[file_name]] <- readRDS(file)
}

# check the names of the ecdf functions
epdf_names <- names(epdf_list)

# remove ".parsed.bed" from the names
epdf_names <- gsub("\\.parsed\\.bed\\.gz", "", epdf_names)

# parse name to get {Genome}.{Cross} split by "."
Genome <- str_split(epdf_names, "_", simplify = TRUE)[,1]
Cross <- str_split(epdf_names, "_", simplify = TRUE)[,2]
```

```{r process epdf functions to generate dataframe}
lapply(
  1:length(epdf_files),
  function(I) data.frame(
              referenceFraction=seq(0,0.99,0.01),
              percentile=unlist(lapply(seq(0,0.99,0.01), function(X) integrate(epdf_list[[I]], lower = X, upper = X+0.01)[[1]] )),
              Genome=Genome[I],
              Cross=Cross[I]
            )
) %>% bind_rows() -> ReferenceFraction_Percentile_Data

ReferenceFraction_Percentile_Data$Genome <- gsub("Pangenome", "Pangenome", ReferenceFraction_Percentile_Data$Genome)
ReferenceFraction_Percentile_Data$Genome <- gsub("BWA", "mm10", ReferenceFraction_Percentile_Data$Genome)
```
